blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Sapperton. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Sapperton, New Westminster: 10 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 7 of 14 New Westminster communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the New Westminster total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Sapperton fell from 19 in June to 10 in September (−47.4%), and 6 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 6.1% of New Westminster’s 164 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Sapperton?
Sapperton also had 33 condos and townhomes listed and 2 sold in September, against 10 houses listed. The Sapperton condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Sapperton home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

14 houses sold in Sapperton with a median price of $1,420,000 (the middle half sold between $1,252,175 and $1,536,875), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $585 per square foot, a median year built of 1948 and a median lot of 5,108 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Sapperton?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 houses listed in Sapperton. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sapperton a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Sapperton had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Sapperton from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses sold in Sapperton over those 4 months, out of 60 in all of New Westminster.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Sapperton?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Sapperton sell for?
faq.a: 14 houses sold in Sapperton between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,420,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Sapperton?
faq.a: The median was 26 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.4% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
